# outputs/ — map of the generated files

Everything here is generated by `code/Group_8_Image_Recognition.ipynb`. Nothing in this folder is
needed to understand the project; it is kept so the numbers in the report can be traced back.

Paths matter in three places only: the notebook writes to `outputs/run_448px_binary/`,
`outputs/run_bit_384px_binary/`, `outputs/resized_384/` and `outputs/resized_448/` with names derived
from the image size. **Do not rename those four folders**, or the notebook will start training from
scratch and resize all 30,000 images again.

## Deliverable runs (used by the current notebook)

| Folder | What it is | Validation | Test |
|--------|------------|-----------:|-----:|
| `run_448px_binary/` | Model 1, Keras ResNet-50 (ImageNet), 448 px. Holds the figures, `summary.csv`, `test_predictions.csv`, `training_history.csv`, the executed notebook and the ensemble results. | 0.8948 | 0.9035 |
| `run_bit_384px_binary/` | Model 2, BiT-M ResNet-50x1 (ImageNet-21k), trained at 384 px and evaluated at 448 px. Holds its weights and history; the averaged (final) model is evaluated into `run_448px_binary/`. | 0.8975 | 0.9095 |

The final model averages the two softmax outputs: **validation 0.9075, test 0.9148**.

Weights (`model/*.weights.h5`, 250–350 MB each) are **not** in git, they exceed GitHub's 100 MB file
limit. They stay on the machine that trained them; running the notebook regenerates them.

## Caches (large, not in git)

| Folder | Content |
|--------|---------|
| `resized_384/`, `resized_448/` | All 30,926 images pre-scaled once to that size. **Used by the notebook.** |
| `cache/resized_224/`, `cache/resized_299/` | Caches of the retired 224 px run and the InceptionV3 comparison. Kept for reference, nothing reads them. |

## `history/` — earlier runs, one folder per configuration

Each folder keeps the same layout: `summary.csv`, `training_history.csv`, `test_predictions.csv`,
`figures/`, `model/`, and the executed notebook where one was saved. Superseded by the final model;
kept because the report's Part 1 discussion of what did not work is based on them.

| Folder | Setup | Validation | Test |
|--------|-------|-----------:|-----:|
| `run_224px_lesion_split/` | v1, 224 px, 7 classes, lesion-level split | 0.8528 | 0.8422 |
| `run_384px/` | v2, 384 px, lesion-level split | 0.8613 | 0.8595 |
| `run_384px_image_split/` | v3, image-level split | 0.8575 | 0.8756 |
| `run_384px_image_split_reg/` | v4, stronger regularisation | 0.8509 | 0.8636 |
| `run_384px_image_split_meta/` | v5, patient metadata + HAM10000 fine-tune stage | 0.8495 | 0.8583 |
| `run_384px_resnet152/` | v6, ResNet-152 backbone | 0.8555 | 0.8643 |
| `run_384px_binary/` | v7, benign / malignant, binary head | 0.8915 | 0.9015 |
| `run_384px_binary_v2/` | v8, weaker regularisation, 12 epochs (also holds the earlier 2-model weight average) | 0.8908 | 0.8975 |
| `run_384px_binary_v3/` | v9, whole backbone unfrozen, 10 epochs | 0.8961 | 0.9042 |

The first five runs predict 7 classes; their validation and test numbers are 7-class accuracy. The
report's benign / malignant discussion uses the binary runs (v7 onwards).

## `reports/` — report build artifacts

| Path | Content |
|------|---------|
| `Report_final.docx`, `Report_final.pdf` | Final report, the version uploaded to the shared Google Doc. |
| `FORMAT_CHECK_REPORT.md`, `GUIDELINE_CHECK_REPORT.md` | Checks run against the assignment guideline before submission. |
| `part2/` | Part 2 draft, its equations and images. |
| `history/` | Earlier report builds (`before_humanize`, `before_project_title`, `pre_content_fix`, `titlefixed_backup`) and the executed notebook backup they were made from. |

## Other folders

| Folder | Content |
|--------|---------|
| `experiments/` | Backbone comparison: `inceptionv3_299/` (val 0.8356, test 0.8470), `bit_r50x1_384/` (val 0.8915 at 384 px, test 0.9088), `head_check/` (classifier-head sweep on frozen ResNet-152 features), `bit_download/` (the 260 MB ImageNet-21k checkpoint), and `comparison.txt` with all the numbers. |
| `colab/` | Colab-only backbone experiment (EfficientNetV2S / ConvNeXtTiny) and the 1 GB data bundle it needs. Not part of the deliverable. |
| `kaggle/` | Copy of the notebook as uploaded to Kaggle. |
